note: Adapted from the species description in Chhotani (1997), the original being in English; soldier, worker and alate are all treated; the synonymy list, literature citations, figure numbers, measurement tables and distribution records are omitted; the degree signs and similar passages are damaged by OCR, and no data absent from the original have been added.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head capsule subrectangular, sides nearly straight, slightly narrowed anteriorly; left mandible weakly twisted with the apex beaked, right mandible blade-like; gula rod-shaped with a slender waist, the narrowest part of the waist near the posterior end. Alate head capsule subcircular, fontanelle plate slit-like and semitransparent, antennae 14-segmented. Worker head subcircular, fontanelle plate a circular to oval semitransparent spot.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule pale yellowish brown, brownish yellow near the base of the mandibles; labrum pale yellow and semitransparent; left mandible black, right mandible reddish brown; body and legs creamy yellow. Head sparsely hairy, body more densely so. Body length about 4.5–7.0 mm. Head capsule subrectangular, sides nearly straight, slightly narrowed anteriorly; head length with mandibles 3.8–4.40 mm, head length to mandibular base 1.70–2.33 mm, maximum head width 1.15–1.40 mm; frons inclined about 45°, anterolateral angles obtusely produced, coronal suture reaching half the head length. Fontanelle transverse, situated at the base of the frontal slope. Antennae 14-segmented, segments 2, 3 and 4 subequal, segment 2 or 4 sometimes slightly shorter than segment 3. Labrum asymmetrical, anterior margin deeply concave, anterolateral margins with several small teeth; labrum length 0.45–0.50 mm, width 0.27–0.35 mm. Mandibles asymmetrical, almost as long as the head length to the mandibular base; left mandible 1.70–2.00 mm long, right mandible slightly smaller; ratio of left mandible length to head length 0.90–1.00. Left mandible weakly twisted, apex beaked, the beak sometimes broken; right mandible blade-like, outer and inner margins of the distal half both weakly incurved, apical blade long, inner margin distinctly incurved. Gula rod-shaped, waist slender, narrowest near the posterior end; gula length 1.0 mm, maximum width 0.35 mm, waist width 0.14 mm. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, anterior lobe semicircular with a weak notch, posterior margin rounded; length 0.25 mm, width 0.73–0.90 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule pale yellow, labrum and postclypeus slightly paler; antennae, thorax and legs creamy white; abdomen transparent, contents showing through. Head and body rather densely hairy. Body length 4.00–4.70 mm. Head subcircular; head length to tip of labrum 1.05–1.25 mm, head length to mandibular base 0.80–0.85 mm, maximum head width 1.00–1.03 mm. Fontanelle plate circular to oval, a semitransparent spot, diameter 0.05–0.07 mm. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 shorter than segment 2, segment 4 shortest. Postclypeus convex and hairy, about half as long as wide; length 0.25–0.26 mm, width 0.53–0.55 mm. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, anterior margin without a notch. Protibial spur very small, sometimes indistinct.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule dark brown; postclypeus, antennae, labrum and pronotum slightly paler than the head capsule; legs yellowish brown; abdominal tergites concolorous with the pronotum, sternites pale brown, brownish yellow medially; wings pale brown and transparent. Head and body densely covered with short fine hairs and a few longer setae; wing margins ciliate, wing membrane with only a few hairs. Body length with wings 10.8–12.0 mm, without wings 6.5–7.0 mm. Head capsule subcircular; head length to tip of labrum 1.25–1.35 mm, head length to mandibular base 0.85–0.90 mm, maximum head width including eyes 1.20–1.23 mm; postclypeus slightly depressed behind; V-shaped suture indistinct. Fontanelle plate narrowly slit-like, semitransparent, length 0.05–0.06 mm. Compound eyes circular, maximum diameter 0.28–0.30 mm, minimum diameter 0.25–0.28 mm. Ocelli broadly oval, length 0.14–0.15 mm, width 0.10 mm, equidistant from the compound eye and from the antennae, mutual distance slightly less than their length (0.125 mm). Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 longer than segment 2, segment 4 shortest. Postclypeus convex, hairy as the head capsule, length slightly less than half its width; length 0.23–0.25 mm, width 0.55–0.60 mm. Labrum dome-shaped, length 0.33–0.35 mm, width 0.40–0.43 mm. Pronotum nearly semicircular, length 0.58–0.60 mm, width 0.95–1.00 mm; anterior margin slightly incurved, without or with a very weak median concavity, posterior margin slightly incurved medially. Fore wing length 9.5–10.0 mm, hind wing length 9.0–9.5 mm.
